Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our dinner meeting scheduled for May 24, 2024, at 19:00 (7:00 PM) at The Gourmet Restaurant. We are looking forward to discussing our future collaboration with Blue Sparrow Tech.

Please let me know if this time works for you or if you need any adjustments.

Blue Sparrow Tech
